requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Configurator enforces SPIKE_CLASH: with piece 0,0,0 half-n and neighbours 0,1 1,0, drawer s41 at 0,0 and spike s42 at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 individually offered but batch apply returns SPIKE_CLASH 'a drawer (south half) fills this corner of the junction, where the spike would stand.' No alternative socket for same corner offered. Current build keeps drawer drawer:0#0,0#cut at 0,0 and closest allowed spike spike:0#0,1|1,0|1,1 at adjacent junction 0,1|1,0|1,1 (meshClear), not same corner.

finish.summary: One drawer and one spike cannot share the same corner of the same cell – configurator refuses with SPIKE_CLASH. Built closest legal proximity to demonstrate rule, verification is clear but requirement is structurally unmet.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
One drawer and one spike cannot occupy the same corner of the same cell in Hex Cluster — the configurator enforces a direct exclusion.

**Attempt:** Cell `0,0` built as `half-n` (`piece:0,0,0;half-n`) with neighboring cells `0,1` and `1,0` to create junction `0,0|0,1|1,0`.

- `find_sockets` offers `s41` drawer at `0,0,0` and `s42` spike at junction `0,0|0,1|1,0` individually.
- Batch `apply` both: drawer placed, spike refused:

> `SPIKE_CLASH: a drawer (south half) fills this corner of the junction, where the spike would stand. Take the drawer off, or use another junction.`

No alternative socket for the same corner is offered — the rule is absolute.

**Build left for verification** is the closest legal proximity the system allows:
- Drawer `drawer:0#0,0#cut` on cell `0,0` (south face of the half)
- Spike `spike:0#0,1|1,0|1,1` at the next junction `0,1|1,0|1,1` (added after placing helper cells `0,2` and `1,1`)

`check_build` = `ok:true`, `meshClash:clear` — but the spike is **not** at the same corner as the drawer.

Requirement is therefore structurally impossible without violating `SPIKE_CLASH`.
